description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of Surge Engine until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Surge Engine's third ability by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
